senses.gloss: ch. = h.<cite ref="M01208"><he>מִין</he> III</cite> <cite ref="Berakhot 58a:10">Ber. 58ᵃ</cite> Ms. M. (ed. <he>צדוקי</he>).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 7:13:3">Y. Snh. VII, 25ᵈ</cite> top <he>חמתון חד מיניי וכ׳</he> a certain Min saw them, and said what he said (a conjuration).
<cite ref="Yoma 2a:8">Ib.</cite> <he>מי נפיק אהן מינייא</he> when that Min came out.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 7:13:3">Ib.</cite> bot. <he>חד מ׳ נסיב צריר וכ׳</he> a Min took up a pebble and threw it up &c.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מִינָאֵי</he>, <cite ref="M01210"><he>מִינַיָּיא</he></cite>, <he>מִינֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:8:4">Koh. R. to I, 8</cite> <he>עבדון ליה מ׳ מִלָּא</he> the Minin did something (some sorcery) to him.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 4a:11">Ab. Zar. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>משתבח</he> … <he>למ׳ וכ׳</he> R. Ab. praised R. S. to the Minin (in office) as being a great scholar; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Shabbat 133b:17">Sabb. 133ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>שב מינאי</he>, read <he>מָנָאֵי</he>, v. <cite ref="M01724"><he>מָנֶה</he></cite>.]
